title: The Portrait of Harrow Glen
author: Sebastian Vane
blurb: Casper Yarrow, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
